package.name: sdsm_trust_interfaces
package.description: Message definitions for the SDSM trust layer: the envelope that carries one veins_ros_bridge TX/RX event (sdsm_msgs/SensorDataSharingMessage plus which simulated node sent or received it) and the per-sender verdict a sdsm_trust_perception TrustEngine produces from judging it. Ported from CPX-Mono's global_trust_perception second-layer trust pipeline (ros2/src/sdsm_interfaces, ros2/src/global_trust_perception) — see that repo for the full design writeup.
